description: Zinc anchors designed to attach termination bars to concrete or masonry walls.
hts_note: Zinc anchors are base metal articles not provided for elsewhere and are classified as other articles of zinc.

description: Eight styles of office planners and calendars designed for use as appointment books or scheduling.
hts_note: Office planners and appointment books are classified as bound diaries under heading 4820.

description: Cast iron electrical conduit articles used for electrical conduit systems.
hts_note: Cast iron conduit fittings and joints of base metal not lined with insulating material are classified as cast fittings of iron or steel.

description: Melamine-based flame retardant chemical products, including melamine cyanurate, melamine polyphosphate, and ammonium-melamine-piperazine polyphosphate, produced by chemically reacting melamine raw material with other feedstocks.
hts_note: Melamine-based flame retardants such as melamine cyanurate and melamine polyphosphate are heterocyclic compounds containing an unfused triazine ring.

description: Two-layer wood flooring panels consisting of two layers or plies of wood rather than two or more veneer layers in combination with a core.
hts_note: Classified as assembled multilayer wood flooring panels consisting of a wear layer laminated to a backing layer.

description: Wood flooring product of a two-layer construction composed of one layer or ply of wood veneer in combination with a finger-jointed board.
hts_note: Classified as multilayer assembled flooring panels with a face ply of 6 mm or less.

description: Wood flooring product of a two-layer construction composed of one layer or ply of wood veneer in combination with an Oriented Strand Board (OSB) core.
hts_note: Classified as veneered panels of wood with an outer ply of non-coniferous wood and a particle board or OSB core under heading 4412.

description: Wood flooring product composed of a single thin solid wood layer glued to a single solid wood bottom layer.
hts_note: Classified as multilayer assembled flooring panels under heading 4418.

description: Wood flooring composed of two or more outer plies of exotic wood species laminated to a wooden core.
hts_note: Classified as multilayer assembled flooring panels other than bamboo or mosaic under heading 4418.

description: Oil tube adapters used with pumps.
hts_note: Classified as other tube or pipe fittings of iron or nonalloy steel, excluded from chapter 84 as parts of general use.

description: Magnetic sheets for metal paper-cutting dies, consisting of flexible magnets permanently bonded with paper printed with text and decorative motifs.
hts_note: Flexible magnetic sheets used to hold metal dies are classified as other permanent magnets of the flexible type.

description: Steel concrete reinforcing bar that has undergone further processing with an epoxy coating.
hts_note: Steel reinforcing bars (rebar) with deformations from the rolling process remain classified under heading 7214 even when provided with a protective epoxy coating.

description: Thirteen types of automotive and cylinder tubes composed of mechanical tubing.
hts_note: Seamless cold-drawn circular tubes of nonalloy steel used for mechanical applications, such as automotive and cylinder tubing.

description: Zinc and nylon anchors designed to attach wood, metal, shelf brackets, and other items to concrete, brick, and other masonry walls, ceilings, and floors.
hts_note: Zinc anchors are classified as other articles of zinc, as Chapter 79 does not have a dedicated heading for base metal fasteners.

description: Finished light poles and light pole kits incorporating aluminum extrusions, intended for supporting lighting fixtures.
hts_note: Finished aluminum light poles and structural kits are classified as aluminum structures and parts of structures under subheading 7610.90.

description: Bathroom accessory kits consisting of towel bars, towel rings, and toilet paper holders made with extruded aluminum components.
hts_note: Bathroom accessories such as towel bars, towel rings, and toilet paper holders of base metal are classified as brackets and similar fixtures under heading 8302.

description: Pocket door frame kits containing components used to assemble a pocket door frame.
hts_note: Pocket door frame kits composed primarily of steel components to assemble a door frame are classified as steel door frames under heading 7308.

description: Air duct registers composed of aluminum extrusions, designed for use in heating, ventilation, and air conditioning systems.
hts_note: Air duct registers made of aluminum are classified as other articles of aluminum not specifically provided for elsewhere.

description: Barn door hardware kits consisting of the necessary hardware components used for installing a sliding barn door.
hts_note: Sliding barn door hardware kits consisting of base metal components for buildings are classified as other mountings and fittings suitable for buildings.

description: Twelve different outdoor products, comprising ten finished goods kits and two other outdoor products constructed with aluminum components.
hts_note: Classified as other articles of aluminum, not elsewhere specified or included.

description: Pallets made of series 6xxx aluminum alloy extrusions that are cut to length and welded together.
hts_note: Welded aluminum pallets are classified as other articles of aluminum under subheading 7616.99.5190.

description: Dining chair kits composed of aluminum extrusions that require further finishing and lack component parts for completion.
hts_note: Because the kits lack essential components to be classified as complete chairs under GRI 2(a), they are classified as other parts of seats of heading 9401, which excludes them from chapter 76 pursuant to Section XV Note 1(k).

description: Fourteen storage cabinet models and 15 quick assembly bookcase models featuring an open box design that provides structural integrity without vertical support members and lacking horizontal support members for shelf placement.
hts_note: Classified as other wooden furniture, specifically bookcases, shelves, and other library furniture.

description: New pneumatic off-the-road tires designed for mining and construction vehicles, including 37.5-39 tires for Caterpillar 657E Wheel Tractor-Scrapers, 45/65-45 tires for Caterpillar 992K Wheel Loaders, and 27.00-49 tires for Caterpillar 777G Off-Highway Trucks.
hts_note: Classified as new pneumatic tires of rubber of a kind used on construction or mining vehicles and machines, having a rim diameter exceeding 61 cm.

description: Short round circular welded carbon-quality steel tubes.
hts_note: Classified under heading 7306 as other welded tubes and pipes of circular cross section of nonalloy/carbon steel.

description: TreeKeeper's Adjustable Telescoping OrnamentKeeper, an ornament storage and handling device incapable of sliding under a load to lift and move it, and the XL Tree Dolly, a wheeled dolly designed for moving trees.
hts_note: Classified as other non-mechanically propelled vehicles because the wheeled dolly/handling device lacks a projecting edge to slide under loads to lift them, distinguishing it from traditional hand trucks.

description: Luggage cart, style No. CRT39, capable of sliding under a load and without a telescoping frame.
hts_note: Classified as a non-mechanically propelled vehicle (hand cart/truck) not designed specifically for industrial use.

description: Black and perforated square tubes.
hts_note: Classified as welded tubes or hollow profiles of square cross-section, made of iron or nonalloy steel with a wall thickness under 4 mm.

description: Two-layer wood flooring products composed of fewer than two layers or plies of wood veneer combined with a core.
hts_note: Classified as multilayer assembled wood flooring panels composed of a wood veneer wear layer attached to a core layer under heading 4418.

description: Ductile iron flanges identified by product codes DPF003 and DPF004.
hts_note: Cast pipe or tube fittings of ductile iron, including flanges, are classified under subheading 7307.19.30.

description: Unfinished packoff support bushings, unfinished mandrel casing hangers, and unfinished casing head housings intended for use in above-ground multibowl wellhead systems.
hts_note: Classified as parts of boring or sinking machinery for oil and gas field extraction under heading 8431.

description: Glycol-modified polyethylene terephthalate (PETG) shrink film that is not bi-axially oriented.
hts_note: PETG is a polyethylene terephthalate copolymer, and non-biaxially oriented film falls under other PET plates, sheets, film, and strip in heading 3920.

description: Ten seamless steel mechanical pipe products that do not meet the outside diameter and wall thickness dimensional requirements of ASTM A-53, ASTM A-106, or API 5L specifications.
hts_note: Seamless mechanical steel pipe of circular cross section not meeting standard line or standard pipe specifications is classified under other seamless nonalloy steel pipes.

description: 1,1,1,2-Tetrafluoroethane (R-134a) refrigerant produced in Japan and repackaged in a foreign trade zone prior to importation.
hts_note: 1,1,1,2-Tetrafluoroethane (HFC-134a) is specifically provided for under HTSUS subheading 2903.45.00.

description: Refrigerator shelves designed for use as components in refrigerators.
hts_note: Refrigerator shelves are classified as parts of refrigerating equipment under subheading 8418.99.

description: Artist canvases that are woven in India, primed in Cambodia, and then cut, stretched, framed, or packaged in China.
hts_note: Prepared painting canvas, whether or not stretched on a wooden frame, is specifically provided for under this subheading.

description: C1S Poplar Super FBB packaging paperboard product featuring a thickness greater than 310 μm and a density of less than 0.70 g/cm³.
hts_note: Coated one side (C1S) multi-ply folding boxboard (FBB) made of bleached layers and exceeding 150 g/m².

description: Chinese-style prepackaged shrimp dumplings and shrimp Chinese chive dumplings consisting of shrimp and chive fillings encased in dumpling wrappers.
hts_note: Prepackaged dumplings with a dough wrapper enclosing a filling are classified as stuffed pasta, excluded from Chapter 16 by Chapter 16 Note 2.

description: Empty cylinders meeting Department of Transportation specification 39 (DOT-39).
hts_note: Classified as containers for compressed or liquefied gas made of iron or steel.

description: Ductile iron flanges identified by product codes FLD02SP, FLD03SP, FLD04SP, FLD0403, FLD0604, FLD0804, FLDTFS02, FLDTFS03, FLDTFS04, FL250D03, and FL250D04.
hts_note: Classified as cast tube or pipe fittings of ductile iron.

description: An electronic exhaust gas recirculation (EEGR) base identified by product code GM-EEGR Base 440-389136, used in automotive systems.
hts_note: An electronic exhaust gas recirculation (EEGR) valve base is classified as a part of a valve or regulator of heading 8481.

description: Seal2Go Model A plastic bag, typically used for carryout packaging.
hts_note: Plastic carryout and delivery packaging bags made of polymers of ethylene are classified under subheading 3923.21.

description: Plastic pockets that are neither bonded nor laminated to magnetic material.
hts_note: Plastic pockets used for office or school organization are classified as office or school supplies of plastics.

description: Non-printed magnetic label holders, a magnetic label holder featuring a zebra print design, and magnetic panel protector kits with partial lamination designed to temporarily affix to the exterior sides of 2007-2017 two-door Jeep Wrangler vehicles for off-road protection.
hts_note: Classified as other permanent magnets and articles intended to become permanent magnets, specifically flexible magnets.

description: Strike pin anchors consisting of two or more pieces designed for fastening applications.
hts_note: Strike pin anchors consisting of multiple pieces (typically a threaded body, expansion mechanism/pin, nut, and washer) are classified as bolts entered with their nuts and washers under subheading 7318.15.20.

description: Steel threaded rod components designed for use as parts of joint restraint kits.
hts_note: Steel threaded rods used as joint restraint components are classified as threaded steel studs with a diameter of 6 mm or more.

description: Sorelle Petite Paradise Collection Infant Organizer/Storage Unit, a wooden storage piece designed with physical characteristics suitable for infant clothing storage.
hts_note: Classified as other wooden furniture of a kind used in the bedroom.

description: Heat-treated extruded aluminum products meeting the chemical specifications for 5050 grade aluminum alloy.
hts_note: Extruded shapes or profiles made from aluminum alloys (such as 5050) are classified as other aluminum alloy profiles.

description: Aluminum extrusions made from heat-treated ACS-50 aluminum alloy material meeting the chemical specifications for 5050 grade aluminum alloy.
hts_note: Classified as heat-treated profiles of aluminum alloys under heading 7604.

description: Heat-treated extruded aluminum products meeting the chemical specifications for 5050-grade aluminum alloy, and uncoated paper with a GE brightness of 83 +/- 1 percent.
hts_note: Heat-treated extruded aluminum alloy profiles are classified under heading 7604 as aluminum alloy profiles.

description: Circular welded galvanized mechanical steel tubes with outer diameters outside standard pipe schedules 10, 40, and 80 and fence tubing specifications, as well as engineered and manufactured pipe spools fabricated from pipe and butt-weld fittings.
hts_note: Classified as other circular welded mechanical tubing of nonalloy steel with a wall thickness of 1.65 mm or more.

description: Artist canvas that is woven and primed in a third country before being cut, stretched, framed, or packaged.
hts_note: Prepared painting canvas is specifically classified under subheading 5901.90.2000.

description: Neon and white poster board products, where the neon poster board is not coated with inorganic material, intended for uses other than high-quality commercial print graphics using sheet-fed presses.
hts_note: Uncoated paper and paperboard of a kind used for writing, printing, or other graphic purposes, weighing more than 150 g/m².

description: Helical spring lock washers imported as component parts of pole line hardware.
hts_note: Helical spring lock washers of iron or steel are specifically provided for under subheading 7318.21.0030 as parts of general use.

description: Spine-stitched journals constructed from paper.
hts_note: Classified as bound notebooks made of paper under heading 4820.

description: Two-piece anchors, such as masonry anchors, consisting of a zinc, nylon, or steel anchor body paired with an inserted steel pin or nail. They are used for fastening applications where the steel pin and anchor body function together.
hts_note: Classified as other non-threaded articles of iron or steel, as these two-piece drive pin masonry anchors function without screw threads.

description: Countersunk Split Drive (CSD) and Duplex Split Drive (DSD) steel split-drive anchors used as fasteners.
hts_note: Steel split-drive anchors are unthreaded non-rivet fasteners classified under other non-threaded articles of iron or steel.

description: Telescoping pool poles comprising extruded aluminum components and non-aluminum parts, encompassing 360 model numbers across nine model series.
hts_note: Classified as other articles of aluminum, as telescoping pool poles are predominantly made of aluminum and function as handles/attachments for pool cleaning tools.

description: Fluoropolymer-coated cut sheets that have undergone further manufacturing operations in the United Kingdom.
hts_note: Because the plastic cut sheets have undergone further manufacturing operations beyond being cut into rectangles, they are excluded from heading 3921 by Chapter 39 Note 10 and classified as other articles of plastics.

description: Drapery rod kits containing rods and components for hanging draperies.
hts_note: Classified as base metal curtain and drapery rods, poles, and fittings suitable for buildings.

description: Six models of collapsible shelter frames designed to provide structural support for portable shelters or canopies.
hts_note: Collapsible steel frames for portable canopies and shelters are classified as other structures and parts of structures of iron or steel.

description: Pipe spools prefabricated and assembled entirely from third-country pipe and fitting components.
hts_note: Prefabricated pipe spools assembled from steel pipes and fittings are classified as other structures and parts of structures of iron or steel.

description: Carbon steel butt-weld pipe fittings featuring openings with inside diameters both above and below 14 inches, having at least one opening greater than 14 inches.
hts_note: Carbon steel butt-weld pipe fittings with an inside diameter of 360 mm (approx. 14 inches) or more fall under subheading 7307.93.40.

description: Specialized seamless carbon and alloy steel pipe.
hts_note: Seamless pipes of alloy steel, circular cross-section, not cold-drawn or cold-rolled, are classified under subheading 7304.59.80.

description: Crimp drive anchors, which are a type of masonry anchor used for fastening.
hts_note: Crimp drive anchors are non-threaded iron or steel masonry expansion fasteners classified as other non-threaded articles of heading 7318.

description: Composite panels consisting of sheets of corrosion-resistant steel bonded to a plastic core, designed for use in semi-trailer enclosures.
hts_note: Composite panels specifically designed for use in semi-trailer bodies are classified as other parts of trailers and semi-trailers.

description: Scotch Corporation's Bucket Master, a bucket handling or moving device constructed without a frame, projecting edge, or toe plate.
hts_note: Classified as other non-mechanically propelled vehicles, as it is a wheeled manual transport device lacking the standard frame and toe plate of traditional industrial hand trucks.

description: Freezer shelves constructed entirely of sheet metal.
hts_note: Classified as parts of refrigerating or freezing equipment under heading 8418.

description: Flooring underlay consisting of raw flexible magnet sheet.
hts_note: Flexible magnet sheets intended for magnetic flooring underlay are classified under heading 8505 as non-metal permanent magnet flexible sheets.

description: Rectangular and profiled Primelock-branded softwood trim boards with widths of 8, 10, or 12 inches, either edge-glued or not edge-glued, as well as corrosion-resistant steel components for pool kits and pool walls.
hts_note: Classified as continuously shaped (profiled) coniferous wood trim boards under heading 4409.

description: Non-galvanized mechanical steel tubing produced to ASTM A-513 specifications, comprising 176 distinct types.
hts_note: ASTM A-513 covers welded carbon and alloy steel mechanical tubing, classified under welded circular nonalloy steel tubes and pipes as mechanical tubing.

description: Tool chests and cabinets packaged in either wooden crates or corrugated boxes bearing packaging marking codes 5607CH, 5611TC, 4108CH, 4111TC, 3608CH, and 3606TC.
hts_note: Classified as metal furniture, specifically metal tool chests and cabinets.

description: Tributyl citrate (TBC), an organic ester chemical compound.
hts_note: Tributyl citrate is an ester of citric acid classified under esters of citric acid, other.

description: Finished diamond sawblades regardless of the Rockwell hardness level of their cores, and cupwheels featuring segments attached to the bottom of the cores.
hts_note: Diamond sawblades and cupwheels featuring agglomerated diamond abrasive cutting segments on a core are classified as grinding or cutting wheels of agglomerated synthetic or natural diamond under heading 6804.

description: Finished components of refrigerated merchandising and display structures, identified by part numbers R10447, P0228321, 250172, and 250355.
hts_note: Classified as parts of refrigerating or freezing equipment under heading 8418.

description: Certain radial spare tires designed for use as replacement tires.
hts_note: Radial pneumatic rubber replacement tires for passenger motor vehicles are classified under radial passenger car tires in heading 4011.

description: New pneumatic rubber tires of a size listed in the passenger vehicle section of the Tire and Rim Association Year Book, which do not have a DOT symbol stamped on their sidewalls.
hts_note: New pneumatic radial tires of a kind used on motor cars, including racing cars that lack DOT certification, are classified under subheading 4011.10.10 (8-digit provided due to unspecified rim size).

description: A wooden chest featuring specific design characteristics distinguishing it from bedroom chests.
hts_note: Classified as other wooden furniture not of a kind used in the bedroom.

description: Two chests featuring physical characteristics that distinguish them from bedroom chests.
hts_note: Classified as other wooden furniture since the physical characteristics distinguish the chests from wooden bedroom furniture.

description: Cold-rolled steel produced from hot-rolled steel substrate.
hts_note: Classified as flat-rolled iron or non-alloy steel of a width of 600 mm or more, cold-rolled, in coils, with a typical thickness exceeding 1 mm but less than 3 mm.

description: Corrosion-resistant steel products produced from carbon hot-rolled or cold-rolled steel flat products.
hts_note: Corrosion-resistant flat-rolled carbon steel products typically consist of flat-rolled iron or nonalloy steel coated or plated with zinc (galvanized) of a width of 600 mm or more.

description: Railroad ties used to support rail tracks.
hts_note: Railroad ties of wood are classified as railway or tramway sleepers under heading 4406, typically nonconiferous and impregnated.

description: Shakes and shingles made of cedar wood, typically used for roofing and siding applications.
hts_note: Classified under heading 4418 as builders' carpentry of wood, specifically shingles and shakes.

description: Steel coupling stock products manufactured to API 5L specifications with specific combinations of outer diameter and wall thickness, as well as suspension foil.
hts_note: Seamless steel pipe manufactured to API 5L specifications used for line pipe applications.

description: Threaded or grooved CEREICO brand steel branch outlets.
hts_note: Threaded or grooved steel branch outlets are classified as other steel tube or pipe fittings.

description: Hardwood plywood that has been cut-to-size, painted, laminated, stained, ultra violet light finished, grooved, covered in paper, or edge-banded, as well as shipments of hardwood plywood that do not qualify as ready-to-assemble kitchen cabinets.
hts_note: Classified as hardwood plywood consisting solely of sheets of wood each ply not exceeding 6 mm in thickness, with at least one outer ply of specified non-coniferous wood, worked or surface-finished.

description: Electrical conduit fittings, including conduit bodies ranging from 1/2 inch to 4 inches in diameter meeting UL 514A standards with box-fill information, as well as cast iron electrical conduit nipples, couples, and connectors meeting UL 514B standards.
hts_note: Classified as cast pipe or conduit fittings of malleable iron, threaded or grooved, under heading 7307.

description: Trolley for MAKPAC, Model #TR00000002, designed for moving loads but lacking a projecting edge or toe plate capable of sliding under a load.
hts_note: The item is a hand-propelled cart or trolley lacking a toe plate, classifying it as other non-mechanically propelled vehicles.

description: Grooved and threaded ductile iron fittings, specifically models 730ERS, 750, 510DE, 730ES, and 40-5.
hts_note: Classified as cast tube or pipe fittings of ductile iron, specifically grooved fittings under subheading 7307.19.30.

description: Certain radial spare tires designed and marketed exclusively for temporary or emergency use, specifically those listed in Table PCT-1B of the 2014 Tire and Rim Association Year Book and Table PCT-1R of the 2017 Tire and Rim Association Year Book.
hts_note: Classified as new pneumatic radial tires of rubber, of a kind used on motor cars, specifically temporary-use spare tires.

description: Cold-rolled steel produced from hot-rolled steel substrate.
hts_note: Classified as flat-rolled iron or non-alloy steel of a width of 600 mm or more, cold-rolled, in coils, with a typical thickness exceeding 1 mm but less than 3 mm.

description: Door thresholds designed for installation at the bottom of door openings.
hts_note: Classified under aluminum doors, windows and their frames and thresholds for doors.

description: SAFELET and UNILET fire-protection weld outlets featuring a threaded end and a fish mouth opening designed for connection to pipe in fire-protection systems.
hts_note: The product is a non-cast steel pipe branch outlet fitting with a threaded outlet connection, classified as other threaded pipe fittings of iron or steel.

description: Threaded and grooved (cooplet) weld outlets made of carbon steel for use as pipe fittings.
hts_note: Classified as other tube or pipe fittings of iron or nonalloy steel, not elsewhere specified.

description: Stainless steel castings for pipe fittings produced to ASTM A351 Grades CF8 and CF8M standards, with a maximum carbon content of 0.08 percent.
hts_note: Cast stainless steel pipe fittings and rough casting blanks for fittings fall under cast fittings of iron or steel, other than nonmalleable cast iron or ductile iron.

description: Electrical conduit fittings, including conduit bodies, conduit nipples, and conduit couplings and connectors, designed and manufactured to conform to electrical industry codes and standards for electrical applications.
hts_note: Electrical conduit fittings of base metal (unlined) are classified as pipe and tube fittings of iron or steel under heading 7307 as parts of general use.

description: NT Torque Tubes made of circular welded carbon quality steel mechanical tubing.
hts_note: Classified as other welded circular cross-section mechanical tubing of carbon/nonalloy steel with a wall thickness of 1.65 mm or more.

description: Finished diamond sawblade, model SM540 Diamond Wheel, packaged as an accessory for the Dremel Saw-Max SM-20 power tool.
hts_note: Finished diamond saw blades and cutting wheels with an abrasive edge of agglomerated natural or synthetic diamond are classified under subheading 6804.21.

description: MIDEA washing machine model MAD160S2801, a top-loading residential washing machine featuring a vertical rotational axis and a drive train consisting of a permanent split capacitor motor, a belt drive, and a flat wrap spring clutch.
hts_note: Fully-automatic household washing machine with a dry linen capacity not exceeding 10 kg and a top-loading, vertical rotational axis design.

description: Ductile iron lap joint flanges, including models with inside diameters less than six inches (product numbers C11150DI-016-1, C11150DI-024-1, C11150DI-032-1, C11150DI-048-1, and C11150DI-064-1) and models with inside diameters greater than six inches (product numbers C11150DI-096-1, C11150DI-128-1, C11150DI-160-1, and C11150DI-192-1).
hts_note: Classified as cast pipe fittings of ductile iron, other than threaded or grooved.

description: Five types of butterfly clips used for fastening papers, identified by product codes or SKUs A70726108B, A7072610, A7072620B, A7072620, and A7072643.
hts_note: Butterfly paper clips made of base metal wire are classified as paper clips wholly of wire under heading 8305.

description: Medicine cabinets, linen towers, space savers, and hampers designed for bathroom or general household storage rather than bedroom use.
hts_note: Classified as other wooden furniture of a kind used in the home, excluding kitchen or bedroom furniture.
